Vale Guardian.desc:
Before the fight:
  * Designate a Tank, they need to have the highest tougness
  * Designate a couple condition dps for the Red Guardian
  * Have boon strip ready for the Blue Guardian
  * Have some CC ready for breakbars

During the fight:
  * Greens are usually overhealed, Barrier and Protection helps a lot. Otherwise designate 4 people to stand in green circles to negate the damage
  * Watch out for Blues, they teleport and deal a lot of damage
  * Knock back or CC red Seekers, they deal AoE damage to the squad
  * Vale Guardian splits at 66% and 33%, couple conditon dps go to the Red Guardian, the Green Guardian is pulled to the Blue Guardian
  * After splits, one and then two segments of the arena glow and deal damage. Always tank on the edge of the safe segment
